thread:
tess: Quick sanity run bringing up v2-quant (Q8) across H100/A100 in us-east / us-west / eu-west. Toggled edge routing mux between `edge-first` and `pop-first`. Noticed eu-west p95 is way higher than the others, suspect routing+kernel combo.
bench-bot: Quick summary (seq=128, batch=1, 60s steady-state samples):
```
us-east  H100 edge-first  p50=32ms  p95=138ms  rps≈28
us-west  H100 edge-first  p50=34ms  p95=152ms  rps≈26
eu-west  H100 edge-first  p50=48ms  p95=322ms  rps≈12
eu-west  H100 pop-first   p50=38ms  p95=178ms  rps≈22
A100 numbers roughly +12%-15% latency vs H100 on same routing.
```
rahul: Can you paste the exact perf command and kernel toggles you used?
tess: Yep:```./run_bench --model v2-q8 --seq 128 --batch 1 --gpu h100 --kernels "attn_fused,matmul_opt" --route edge-first --samples 60```then swapped `--route pop-first` and reran. Also tried `--kernels compat` for eu-west quick check.
ingrid: Interesting — eu-west pop-first drops p95 ~45% vs edge-first. That points to an extra hop / proxy path under edge-first for that POP. Any hop-count diffs?
ops-bot: traceroute from edge-proxy-euw -> pop shows extra hop via regional-proxy-2 (latency ~18ms added) when edge-first path active.
bench-bot: Warmup trace (eu-west, edge-first):
```
0-10s: cold KV cache spikes to 800ms (initial token)
10-30s: cache warms, p50 settles ~50ms but p95 still shows 280-320ms tails intermittently
30-60s: periodic 250-320ms tail ~1-2x/min
```
rahul: Could be two things: kernel selection falling back to slower path under certain sequences or transient network egress. Did you pin kernel version?
tess: For H100 runs I left `--kernels auto`. Quick forced run with `--kernels compat` in eu-west improved p95 to ~210ms but hurt p50 by ~6ms. So there is a kernel vs routing tradeoff.
ingrid: For capacity sizing that's huge. If eu-west p95=320ms, effective 95th throughput per GPU ~12 rps; baseline us-east ~28 rps. You'd need ~2.4x GPUs in eu-west to match user-facing SLA at p95.
rahul: Action items: 1) run per-pop kernel sweep (auto/compat/attn_fused) for both H100 and A100, 2) test with RouteOverride=pop-first in eu-west for 24h canary, 3) add short warmup traffic (seq16 bursts) to fill KV cache before user traffic.
tess: I'm starting 1) now — kicking off sweep for H100/A100 with samples=120, will attach per-request latency histogram.
ops-bot: FYI rolled a temporary route-override flag in staging: `/flags route_override eu-west pop-first` if you want to test at scale. Be cautious about cost.
bench-bot: Note re: quantization: Q8 stable for quality but Q4 experiments (toy run) show slight token-level regressions on some prompts; will separate evals.
ingrid: Let's also log kernel selection per-request in the console dashboard for the next canary so we can correlate slow tails with kernel+route.
rahul: If eu-west improves with pop-first we'll consider a soft routing policy: prefer pop-first for quant models until kernel heuristics improve.
tess: Uploading raw CSVs to the benchmark bucket and will post a short binder with the histograms in #eng-ml when ready. TL;DR: routing mux causes large p95 variance in eu-west; kernel toggle helps but tradeoffs exist. Warmup/KV caching mitigates spikes.
